A target value that equals the source value.

The check is off by default.



## Configure

Turn the check on in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from 'x18n'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'identical-to-source': 'warning',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only identical-to-source` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip identical-to-source` skips it for one run.
